nodes.text: Rescue the four animals in Ridgewater Retreat: release Raidu from the incense container, then find the rabbit in the nearby basket; untie Taichek from the large rock; free Dumen from the fire; and uncover Ongke beside the grassy rock and fish remains. Use the live markers to find the remaining animal.

recovery.text: The rabbit requires a second interaction after leaving the container. Ongke can blend into the ground. Target the named animal and follow its live objective rather than treating arrival as rescue.
